notes.title: Yuri Cyberpunk Thriller Synergia has been released!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

It's been a long time coming, but we are proud to announce that Synergia is finally live! After 4 years, the game is finally out. Synergia is a unique cyberpunk yuri thriller, wrapped up in a neon artstyle.

One android's fate may spell the difference between peace, war, the blossoming of a new religion, or a technological singularity beyond comprehension.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1047010/Synergia/

The game features over 100+ unique CGs & BGs, multiple endings, and up to an estimated 10+ hours of gameplay. Also includes steam achievements! The game will run a 10% discount for the week of its release.

notes.title: Just 24 hours til Release!

Hello everyone!

Just a quick update, dropping in to let everyone know the game will be release [b]completely uncensored[/b] tomorrow at 12PM EST. The game will be $10.99, but will launch with a 10% discount that will run for one week. We hope you'll all enjoy the game! See you tomorrow for the release.

notes.title: Releasing on March 30th!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Just another quick update! We're happy to announce that Forest Guardian has been fully approved, and will release completely UNCENSORED next Monday, March 30th! The game will launch with a 10% discount that will run for one week. 

Hope to see you then!
